title: On extensive amenability of algebras
summary: For a module \(M\) over a cocommutative Hopf algebra \(\mathscr A\), we define extensive amenability by amenability of its symmetric algebra as a module over \(\operatorname{Sym}(M)\#\mathscr A\). Using the author's coalgebraic rounding and quotient theorems, we prove that nonzero extensively amenable modules are amenable, that every module over an amenable Hopf algebra is extensively amenable, and that extensive amenability is preserved and reflected by short exact sequences.
